subject: a marble whistle folded like soft ribbon
pose: folded into a compact rising S curve
art_direction: 一枚厚重大理石口哨弯成柔软带状，孔洞流出一片金属水滴，粉黑白对比鲜明。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Sculpt a whistle from white marble, then bend its body into a soft S-shaped ribbon as though the stone were flexible. Preserve the unmistakable mouthpiece and sound opening, with a single polished brass droplet suspended just outside the opening. The marble veining follows the bend naturally and remains sparse. Tilt the mouthpiece upward in a cheeky gesture, without facial features. Use a dusty pink background and a deep charcoal shadow that separates the loop from the body. Concentrate fine material detail around the sound opening and the folded edge. The object fills the central seventy-five percent of the square, with no tiny fragments or text and ample circular-crop clearance.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
